aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We are a Germany-registered non-profit organization dedicated to facilitating mutual collaboration, knowledge exchange, and sustainable development opportunities across Africa and Germany.
aboutPage.missionText: Impakt Gateway connects institutions, organizations and people in Africa and Germany to build sustainable partnerships, unlock opportunities and support initiatives that improve lives and strengthen communities.
aboutPage.visionText: A future in which meaningful connections between African nations and Germany create lasting opportunities, stronger communities and sustainable, self-reliant development.
aboutPage.journeyNote: Built on reciprocal relationships, shared purpose, and authentic continental solidarity.
aboutPage.principlesDescription: We believe international development thrives on reciprocity, dignity, and local ownership rather than one-way charity.
aboutPage.p1Desc: Development is not a one-way transfer. We foster equal partnerships grounded in mutual learning, respect, and human dignity.
aboutPage.p2Desc: We prioritize long-term, systemic relationships over quick, transient interventions that leave no lasting foundation.
aboutPage.p3Desc: Communities best understand their own challenges and solutions. We support and amplify local African initiatives and leaders.
aboutPage.p4Desc: We communicate our progress honestly, never exaggerating numbers or claiming impact we have not yet delivered.
aboutPage.connectionDescription: Our bilateral focus allows us to build deep, meaningful institutional, academic and personal connections with tangible, long-term outcomes.
aboutPage.cameroonItem1: World's youngest, most vibrant demographic & creative talent
aboutPage.cameroonItem2: Rapidly accelerating tech innovation & entrepreneurial energy
aboutPage.cameroonItem3: Strong community structures, grassroots resilience & rich heritage
aboutPage.cameroonItem4: Vast ecological, agricultural & renewable energy leadership

sustainableFocus.manifesto: Impakt Gateway focuses on sustainable development by connecting people, knowledge and resources to create lasting opportunities. Our work supports the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), with a focus on education, youth development, community wellbeing and environmental sustainability. We work with local and international partners to develop practical solutions that create lasting social, economic and environmental impact across Africa and Germany.
sustainableFocus.pillarsDescription: Our integrated approach combines bilateral Africa ↔ Germany partnerships with community-driven implementation across 4 strategic pillars.

pillar1.title: Quality Education & Skills Transfer
pillar1.description: Equipping youth and educational institutions with digital competencies, academic exchange opportunities, and practical vocational training to unlock long-term self-reliance.

pillar2.title: Youth Development & Enterprise
pillar2.description: Fostering entrepreneurship, innovation hubs, leadership mentorship, and career pathways bridging talent across Africa and Germany.

pillar3.title: Community Wellbeing & Health
pillar3.description: Strengthening grassroots community resilience, healthcare knowledge sharing, clean water access, and humanitarian social infrastructure.

pillar4.title: Environmental Sustainability & Climate Action
pillar4.description: Promoting renewable solar energy, ecological stewardship, climate resilience initiatives, and sustainable circular agriculture practices.

sustainableFocus.sdg17Desc: Sustainable progress requires multilateral cooperation. Impakt Gateway builds direct bilateral channels between academic institutions, civil society, diaspora networks, and technical experts in Germany and across Africa.

focusPage.heroSubtitle: Rather than operating in rigid silos, our five focus areas form an integrated ecosystem designed to unlock real opportunities across Africa and Germany.
focusPage.ecosystemDesc: Education builds skills; youth empowerment creates entrepreneurship; health secures resilience; environmental protection preserves resources; and humanitarian support safeguards vulnerable lives during crisis.
focusPage.eduThematic: Key themes: Digital access, technical skills, university partnerships, exchange programs
focusPage.youthThematic: Key themes: Entrepreneurship mentorship, vocational training, startup incubation
focusPage.healthThematic: Key themes: Community health centers, medical knowledge exchange, preventive care
focusPage.envThematic: Key themes: Reforestation, climate adaptation, renewable energy awareness, circular practices
focusPage.humanitarianThematic: Key themes: Rapid community aid, emergency supplies, grassroots resilience

education.title: Education & Lifelong Learning
education.subtitle: Unlocking pathways to quality schooling, technical vocational training, and academic partnerships.
education.challenge: Many young people and educational institutions across African regions face barriers in accessing modern learning materials, digital infrastructure, and international academic exchange networks.
education.approach: We build institutional bridges between German and African universities, schools, and training centers to facilitate knowledge exchange, digital literacy, and resource sharing.
education.bilateralDesc: Connecting German educational institutions, academic researchers, and digital learning platforms with African schools, teachers, and university faculties.
education.action1: Facilitating university-to-university partnerships and research exchange.
education.action2: Supporting digital literacy and modern learning tools in local partner schools.
education.action3: Connecting students with scholarship information and academic opportunities.

youth.title: Youth Empowerment & Entrepreneurship
youth.subtitle: Equipping young talents with practical skills, mentorship, and enterprise development opportunities.
youth.challenge: Youth constitute the overwhelming majority of Africa's population, yet access to vocational mentorship, startup capital, and international professional networks remains constrained.
youth.approach: We link young African creators, innovators, and entrepreneurs with German and international mentors, startup ecosystems, and practical vocational training programs.
youth.bilateralDesc: Creating cross-border mentorship pipelines between German business leaders, technical experts, and energetic African youth innovators.
youth.action1: Promoting vocational training and practical skill incubation.
youth.action3: Connecting young talent with global internships and digital work opportunities.

health.title: Health & Community Well-being
health.subtitle: Improving access to essential healthcare, medical knowledge exchange, and preventative wellness.
health.challenge: Community health centers in many African communities face challenges with specialized medical equipment, ongoing clinical training, and preventative public health resources.
health.approach: We connect healthcare professionals, clinics, and medical organizations in Germany with local community health initiatives in Africa for knowledge exchange and practical equipment support.
health.bilateralDesc: Enabling bilateral medical dialogues, professional knowledge sharing, and logistical coordination for healthcare improvements.
health.action1: Supporting community health clinics with essential supplies and guidance.
health.action2: Facilitating professional exchange between German and African medical experts.
health.action3: Promoting community health education and preventative disease awareness.

environment.title: Environment & Climate Action
environment.subtitle: Promoting conservation, climate resilience, renewable energy awareness, and sustainable resource management.
environment.challenge: Deforestation, climate variability, and environmental degradation threaten critical African ecosystems, biodiversity, and agricultural livelihoods.
environment.approach: We facilitate environmental initiatives focused on reforestation, sustainable agriculture, and clean energy education by partnering with sustainability experts and ecological organizations.
environment.bilateralDesc: Linking German ecological research institutions and green initiatives with grassroots environmental stewards and community forestry projects across Africa.
environment.action1: Supporting community-led reforestation and agroforestry programs.
environment.action2: Promoting climate adaptation and clean energy awareness.
environment.action3: Facilitating ecological research and conservation partnerships.

humanitarian.title: Humanitarian Support & Community Relief
humanitarian.subtitle: Providing transparent, practical assistance to vulnerable communities facing acute crisis and hardship.
humanitarian.challenge: Unforeseen climate events, localized emergencies, and economic hardships leave vulnerable families across impacted African regions in critical need of immediate relief.
humanitarian.approach: We partner with trusted local grassroots organizations to coordinate rapid, transparent, and dignified emergency support for vulnerable populations.
humanitarian.bilateralDesc: Mobilizing targeted humanitarian contributions and solidarity from German donors directly to verified, transparent African community partners.
humanitarian.action1: Delivering rapid, dignified relief supplies to vulnerable families.
humanitarian.action2: Supporting community recovery and emergency assistance funds.
humanitarian.action3: Ensuring 100% transparent tracking of all humanitarian contributions.

partnershipsPage.type1Desc: Facilitate joint research, student exchanges, technical curriculum co-creation, and academic capacity building.
partnershipsPage.type2Desc: Collaborate on verified grassroots projects in education, health, youth empowerment, and ecological preservation.
partnershipsPage.type3Desc: Engage in cross-border mentorship, technology exchange, internship pipelines, and responsible social investment.
partnershipsPage.type4Desc: Fund transparent, high-impact bilateral projects with 100% governance traceability and direct community impact.

partnershipsPage.val1Title: Deep Grassroots & Institutional Networks Across Africa
partnershipsPage.val1Desc: Direct access to verified community structures, local leaders, educational centers, and real on-the-ground needs across the continent.
partnershipsPage.val2Desc: Registered non-profit association (e.V.) adhering to strict German legal, accounting, and transparency standards.

supportPage.heroSubtitle: Your financial support enables us to build institutional bridges, facilitate educational access, mentor youth innovators, and provide dignified community relief across Africa and Germany.
supportPage.whyTitle: Where Your Contribution Makes a Difference
supportPage.why1Desc: Funding digital tools, learning materials, and practical skill-building workshops for students and educators.
supportPage.why2Desc: Supporting young African innovators with structured mentorship, startup incubation, and vocational coaching.
supportPage.why3Desc: Providing rapid, transparent emergency aid and supplies to vulnerable families facing acute hardship.
supportPage.why4Desc: Structuring long-term partnerships, university collaborations, and ecological research exchanges across Africa and Germany.
supportPage.bankDesc: Direct transfer to our official non-profit bank account. Recommended for donations within Germany and the European Union.
supportPage.paypalDesc: Fast and flexible digital donation via PayPal or credit/debit card from anywhere in the world.
supportPage.futurePaymentsDesc: We are currently setting up integrated credit card processing and automated recurring monthly giving. For customized donation pledges, please contact us directly.
supportPage.transparencyText1: Impakt Gateway e.V. is legally registered in Germany as a non-profit association (eingetragener Verein). All donations are allocated exclusively to our statutory non-profit purposes.
supportPage.transparencyText2: Donations from Germany are tax-deductible. We provide official donation receipts (Zuwendungsbestätigungen) upon request for tax filing purposes.

privacy.sec1Desc: Protecting your personal data is a central priority. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with statutory data protection regulations (EU GDPR) and this privacy policy.
privacy.sec2Desc: The controller responsible for data processing on this website under the GDPR is:
privacy.sec3LogDesc: The site provider automatically collects and stores information in server log files transmitted by your browser (browser type, operating system, referrer URL, host name, timestamp, anonymized IP).
privacy.sec4Desc: When you send inquiries via contact form or email, your details are stored for processing the inquiry and follow-up communication.
privacy.sec5Desc: This website uses SSL/TLS encryption for security and to protect confidential inquiries.
privacy.sec6Title: 6. Your Rights as a Data Subject
privacy.sec6Desc: You have the statutory right at any time to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16 GDPR), erasure (Art. 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR), and data portability (Art. 20 GDPR).

cookies.sec1Desc: Protecting your privacy is of paramount importance to Impakt Gateway e.V. We follow a strict privacy-first principle: we do not deploy invasive marketing trackers or third-party profiling cookies.
cookies.sec2Desc: Our website uses essential technical cookies that enable core navigation and security:
cookies.cookie1: Language Preference: Remembers your selected language (English, German, or French).
cookies.cookie2: Security & Anti-Spam: Protects contact and proposal forms against automated attacks.
cookies.sec3Desc: We use privacy-friendly, cookie-less telemetry (Plausible / Vercel Analytics) only with your consent to improve website reliability.
cookies.sec4Desc: You can configure your browser to notify you about cookie placement, allow them on a case-by-case basis, or automatically delete them upon exit.

cookieConsent.bannerDesc: We use essential cookies to ensure our multilingual site operates smoothly. We also use privacy-first, anonymized analytics to measure reach and improve our initiatives.
cookieConsent.modalSubtitle: Customize which cookies and data collection mechanisms you authorize.
cookieConsent.necessaryDesc: Required for language routing, form security, and basic navigation. Cannot be disabled.
cookieConsent.analyticsDesc: Enables anonymized visitor traffic statistics without storing invasive personal tracking profiles.
